delegated_reviews.scope: sanitized project-blind boundary and overlap analysis
findings: Avoid creating a second coordinator or importing lifecycle and routing state.
Treat terminality and strict JSON as package-local semantic inputs rather than production integration claims.
delegated_reviews.resolution: The profile is explicitly one modeled authority, imports no production source, and excludes lifecycle, routing, transport, and coordination implementation.

delegated_reviews.scope: sanitized project-blind quorum terminology and evidence challenge
findings: The word quorum can falsely imply distributed agreement, failure tolerance, intersection, view changes, or atomic handoff.
Receipt validity and the participant failure model must be stated.
delegated_reviews.resolution: README, contract, and handoff now call this a single-authority ratification tally, define receipt validity as syntactic/profile-local, declare no modeled participant failure behavior, and disclaim quorum intersection, equivocation defense, consensus, and atomic handoff.
